scenes.headline: Still waiting for students to trust your course?
scenes.supportingText: The first three seconds have to stop the scroll and promise a real outcome.
scenes.captionText: Still waiting for students to trust your course? Your first three seconds need a stronger hook.

scenes.headline: Generic videos make every offer feel the same
scenes.supportingText: If every ad uses the same pacing, same layout, and same weak CTA, people scroll right past it.
scenes.captionText: Generic videos make every offer feel the same, and low retention kills enrollments.

scenes.headline: Use dynamic scenes built around the voiceover
scenes.supportingText: Remotion packages your AI script, media, and OpenAI voiceover into a sharper story with clean timing.
scenes.captionText: Use dynamic scenes built around the voiceover so the visuals feel intentional, not recycled.

scenes.headline: Show proof, not promises
scenes.supportingText: Highlight outcomes, real student wins, and trust signals so the offer feels credible immediately.
scenes.captionText: Show proof, not promises. Outcomes and trust signals move people closer to applying.

scenes.headline: Turn every generated ad into a clear enrollment push
scenes.supportingText: Keep the message simple, direct, and impossible to miss with a final CTA that actually lands.
scenes.captionText: Turn every generated ad into a clear enrollment push, then ask them to apply now.
